headline: Sunbeth Completes N19.5 Billion Takeover of Livestock Feeds Stake From UAC
summary: Sunbeth Treenuts and Sesame completed its N19.5 billion cash acquisition of UAC of Nigeria's 73.29% controlling stake in Livestock Feeds Plc.
why: Livestock Feeds Plc is a major producer of animal feed listed on the Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.name: Livestock Feeds
impacts.why: Sunbeth finalized purchase of a 73.29% controlling stake in the company.
